item.title: Community Voices featuring Alberta Abbey and Passin’ Art
item.description: Black Nativity, A Gospal Songplay is taking place at Alberta Abbey November 28th thru December 7. We spoke with Alberta Abbey Executive Director Cheri Jamison and Passin' Art's Artistic Director Jerry Foster about the importance of this production and why supporting nonprofits in the inclusion and diversity space are more crucial than ever. The post Community Voices featuring Alberta Abbey and Passin’ Art appeared first on Portland Radio Project.

item.title: Many Roads To Here: Too Late for the American Dream
item.description: Join us this Sunday, January 4th at 4pm for Many Roads to Here, a production of The Immigrant Story, capturing the immigrant experience in the U.S. through monthly profiles. Voices from across the globe offer intimate accounts of immigration, war, genocide, and success. item.description: Portland's Folk Festival is January 30 and 31 at Crystal Ballroom. With a stacked line-up of incredible local artists, it's two days of music worth your while.
